description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans clustering membership table implementation using Azure Cosmos DB. It verifies various operations such as insertion, reading, updating, and concurrency control of membership data stored in Cosmos DB, specifically testing the CosmosMembershipTable and CosmosGatewayListProvider classes. The tests require access to an external Cosmos DB account and are categorized under 'Membership' and 'Cosmos'.

classes.name: CosmosMembershipTableTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying the correct operation of the Orleans Cosmos DB membership table implementation, covering creation, read, update, and concurrency scenarios.

methods.name: CreateFilters
methods.description: Sets up logging filters for CosmosMembershipTable and storage logs.

methods.name: CreateMembershipTable
methods.description: Creates an instance of CosmosMembershipTable configured with test options.

methods.name: CreateGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Creates an instance of CosmosGatewayListProvider for testing gateway list retrieval.

methods.name: GetConnectionString
methods.description: Returns the connection string (account key) for Cosmos DB used during tests.

methods.name: MembershipTable_Cosmos_Init
methods.description: Test initialization for the Cosmos membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_Cosmos_GetGateways
methods.description: Test for retrieving gateway list from Cosmos DB.

methods.name: MembershipTable_Cosmos_ReadAll_EmptyTable
methods.description: Test reading all entries when the membership table is empty.

methods.name: MembershipTable_Cosmos_InsertRow
methods.description: Test inserting a membership row into Cosmos DB.

methods.name: MembershipTable_Cosmos_ReadRow_Insert_Read
methods.description: Test reading a specific row after insertion.

methods.name: MembershipTable_Cosmos_ReadAll_Insert_ReadAll
methods.description: Test reading all rows after multiple insertions.

methods.name: MembershipTable_Cosmos_UpdateRowInParallel
methods.description: Test concurrent updates to ensure optimistic concurrency works.

methods.name: MembershipTable_Cosmos_UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Test heartbeat (liveness) updates in Cosmos DB.
